items: USPS lists January 2027 price change. The Price Change Center now shows a change effective Jan. 17, 2027, with newly posted postage statement redlines and a change log, both revised 11/06/2026. The page gives no price amounts.

EU adds €2 fee per customs line. DHL said a €2 handling fee per import customs declaration line item applies to B2C shipments entering the EU27 from Nov. 1, 2026, regardless of goods value. DHL said it is an EU rule, not specific to DHL Express.

Amazon raises FBA fees from Jan. 15. Most Fulfillment by Amazon fee changes take effect Jan. 15, averaging about 0.8% of the average item's selling price, though some products will cost less to ship. Storage charges change Feb. 1, and Amazon keeps its fuel and logistics surcharge.
